macos.rationale: macOS Apple Silicon desktop app is a documented beta download.

windows.rationale: The complete native desktop download offering is the Apple Silicon macOS beta. The separate cross-platform Commander CLI is a companion to hosted chat, not a desktop app.

linux.rationale: The complete native desktop download offering is the Apple Silicon macOS beta. The separate cross-platform Commander CLI is a companion to hosted chat, not a desktop app.

web-client.rationale: Released browser workspace chat is documented on the homepage and CLI README.

codex.rationale: Commander explicitly launches Codex; MCP access for other agents does not prove their execution.

claude-code.rationale: The product execution adapter directly imports the Claude Agent SDK, launches Claude Code and manages its query/session lifecycle.

cursor.rationale: The inspected Commander native execution selector and runtime adapters are the fixed Codex and Claude Code pair, with no generic executable adapter. MCP client access or model-provider credentials do not add cursor as an executable coding harness.

worktree.rationale: Task Git worktrees and explicit directory permissions are documented.

local.rationale: Agents run on customer-controlled local or headless remote hardware.

own-server.rationale: Agents run on customer-controlled local or headless remote hardware.

vendor-cloud.rationale: The full plan/execution statement explicitly says every plan runs agents on hardware the customer controls with their own credentials. Hosted chat is not hosted coding compute.

cli.rationale: Commander CLI and scoped MCP expose setup and thread context.

parallel-runs.rationale: Multiple coding agents run in parallel under team supervision.

multiplayer.rationale: Multiple humans can prompt and steer agents in a shared thread.

sso.rationale: Enterprise advertises SSO/SAML and SCIM; role names are not documented.

review-ui.rationale: Team reviews proposed diffs and evidence inline in chat.

self-hosting.rationale: Enterprise offers self-hosting; code/context export is advertised without an install recipe.

free-tier.rationale: Personal is ongoing free with no card; Company offers a first free month.

laptop-independent.rationale: Agents run on customer-controlled local or headless remote hardware.

starting-price.rationale: Personal is ongoing free with no card; Company offers a first free month.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete plan schedule is free Personal, flat monthly Company and custom Enterprise, with unlimited agent-hours and customer-owned hardware/credentials. No no-paid-plan ADE charge appears.

usage-based.rationale: The complete plan schedule is free Personal, flat monthly Company and custom Enterprise, with unlimited agent-hours and customer-owned hardware/credentials. No usage-based ADE charge appears.

compute.rationale: The complete plan schedule is free Personal, flat monthly Company and custom Enterprise, with unlimited agent-hours and customer-owned hardware/credentials. No compute ADE charge appears.

one-time.rationale: The complete plan schedule is free Personal, flat monthly Company and custom Enterprise, with unlimited agent-hours and customer-owned hardware/credentials. No one-time ADE charge appears.

paid-from.rationale: Company $100/month. Rechecked against the eligible finding on 2026-11-13: this paid offering remains distinct from no paid plan. Original source-check date retained; independent mapping review cleared for the revised definition.

byo-subscription.rationale: The native execution adapters reuse Codex and Claude Code OAuth accounts, independently of API-key support.

issue-tracking.rationale: Native project issues/groups, durable backlog state and dependency graph exist before explicit coding-job dispatch.

coordinator.rationale: A product-supplied job coordinator plans a DAG, spawns child jobs and inspects/messages workers using shipped scoped tools.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Shipped handlers configure scheduled checks and topic-event wakes, distinct from a manually prompted loop.

pr-workflow.rationale: The native workflow manages a linked GitHub PR and its branch/check/review metadata. This receipt does not promise native PR creation.
